title: Quantum-X Pearl White

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Designed for high-mileage highway touring and demanding daily commutes, the Arai Quantum-X Pearl White is built for mile-crushing grand tours and cross-country adventures. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing 1464g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~83 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Specifically built for riders with a rounder head shape.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Ideal for oval to intermediate head shapes; offers a secure fit with adjustable cheek pads.

technical_analysis: Features Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection paired with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports. The interior utilizes One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Arai Quantum-X Pearl White: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports and One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Arai Quantum-X Pearl White: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Arai Quantum-X Pearl White. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.

introduction: Positioned in Arai's Full Face lineup, the Quantum-X Pearl White brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Arai Quantum-X Pearl White represents Arai's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~83 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Arai Quantum-X Pearl White delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
